beats.say: This man gave up $300 billion… for 800 bucks.
In 1976, he started Apple with Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak.
His name was Ronald Wayne. He owned 10%.
He even drew Apple's very first logo.
But just 12 days later, he panicked.
If Apple failed, he could lose everything he owned.
Today, Apple is one of the biggest companies on Earth.
That 10% could be worth up to $300 billion.
